_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ou se Jwè {player_id} nan Tic Tac Toe.
Objektif ou se genyen twa dèyè yon lòt (anndan, vètikalman, oswa dyagonalman) sou bwò a.
Le ou vini jou, ou ta dwe chwazi nimewo kare a (0-8) ou vle mete mak ou nan pwochen.
Pa egzanp, '[4]' mete mak ou nan selil sant bwò a.
Kom Jwè {player_id}, ou pral ye '{symbol}', pandan ke advè ou se '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mouvman an soumèt pa swiv fòma a kòrèk.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} se pa yon cellule valab. dwe ant 0 ak 8.

game_action.placed: Jwè {player_id} mete senbòl li ({symbol}) nan selil {cell}.

outcome.draw: Jwèt la se yon match nul!
